name: LUNA16 Lung Nodule Analysis Benchmark
description: LUNA16 is a benchmark for pulmonary nodule analysis in low-dose chest CT, focused on candidate detection and false-positive reduction for lung nodules.
evaluation_method: Free-response ROC analysis, especially sensitivity at a fixed number of false positives per scan
general_score_metric: sensitivity at fixed false positives per scan
notes: A standard benchmark for lung nodule detection in CT; evaluation emphasizes clinically relevant operating points rather than pure classification accuracy.
